name: two_tanks_max_work_air
title: Maximum work from two air tanks at 900 K and 300 K
summary: Two rigid vessels of 30 kg of air at 900 K and 300 K are coupled by a heat engine; the reversible (maximum work) end state is computed from the entropy balance of the extended system: both vessels end at the geometric mean temperature 519.6 K and the engine delivers 3.60 MJ.

origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège, MECA0002), repetition session 10 (exergy), exercise 3 (2022-2023)

verification.reference: Closed-form solution of the same entropy balance, computed by hand and compared with compare_solution.py (reference/analytic_reference.csv of the work folder): T_2 = sqrt(T_1a*T_1b) and W = m_air*cv_air*(sqrt(T_1a)-sqrt(T_1b))^2; the ratio eta_max also reproduces the Carnot ratio of the log-mean temperatures 1 - T_c,lm/T_h,lm. The solution stored by EES in the source file cannot be used as a reference (the file was never solved: every variable record holds its EES initial value 1), and the course folder holds no Python/CoolProp solution of this exercise (see README, Verification).
verification.notes: '11 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001)' against the closed-form reference, the largest deviation being the max relative error printed by the solver (1.04e-15). Two variables are excluded from the comparison: cv_air (the CoolProp ideal-gas value, not part of the closed form; it satisfies cp(Air)-cv(Air) = 287.4 J/kg-K, i.e. R_air within 0.13 %) and W_max_delivered (a post-processing output added by the import, equal to -W_max). Status 'runs' and not 'verified' because no independent numerical reference is available for this exercise.
